findings.title: Migration crashes when no category matches the embed_category setting (the common/default case)
findings.body: `category_id = execute("SELECT c.id FROM categories AS c INNER JOIN site_settings AS s ON s.value = c.name WHERE s.name = 'embed_category'")[0]['id'].to_i` assumes the query returns at least one row. Since `embed_category` previously defaulted to an empty string and most installs never set a category whose name equals the setting's raw value, this query will typically return zero rows. Indexing an empty PG::Result with `[0]` yields `nil`, and calling `['id']` on `nil` raises `NoMethodError`, aborting the migration for essentially every existing installation that hasn't explicitly matched a category name to the `embed_category` setting value. This blocks upgrades rather than falling through to the `uncategorized_category_id` fallback that follows.

findings.title: before_validation callback crashes with NoMethodError when host is nil
findings.body: `self.host.sub!(/^https?:\/\//, '')` and the following `sub!` are called unconditionally in `before_validation`, without checking whether `host` is nil. If `host` is nil (e.g. the `embeddable_host` param key is missing in the admin controller, or `EmbeddableHost.new` is used without setting host first), this raises `NoMethodError: undefined method 'sub!' for nil:NilClass` instead of producing a normal validation error, resulting in an unhandled 500 error rather than a controlled validation failure.

findings.title: update/destroy raise NoMethodError (500) instead of 404 for unknown host id
findings.body: `host = EmbeddableHost.where(id: params[:id]).first` returns `nil` when the id doesn't exist. In `update`, `save_host(nil)` then calls `host.host = ...` on nil, raising NoMethodError. In `destroy` (line 15-16), `host.destroy` is called on a potentially nil object with the same result. Both actions will produce an unhandled 500 error instead of a proper 404/`render_json_error` response for a missing record.

findings.title: Unescaped string interpolation into raw SQL INSERT during migration
findings.body: `execute "INSERT INTO embeddable_hosts (host, category_id, created_at, updated_at) VALUES ('#{h}', #{category_id}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP)"` interpolates the `h` value (parsed from the pre-existing `embeddable_hosts` site setting) directly into SQL without escaping. If any historical host value contains a single quote or other SQL metacharacter, this migration will fail or behave unexpectedly. The migration should use parameterized execution (e.g., `ActiveRecord::Base.connection.quote`) instead of raw interpolation.

findings.title: No behavioral test coverage for create/update/destroy of embeddable hosts
findings.body: This spec only asserts that `Admin::EmbeddableHostsController` is a subclass of `Admin::AdminController`. There is no test exercising `create`, `update`, or `destroy`, no test for validation failures, no test for the not-found path (which, per the controller bug, currently 500s), and no test confirming staff-only access is enforced in practice. Given this controller manages the whitelist of hosts allowed to embed content (a security-sensitive feature), the lack of functional test coverage is a significant gap.

findings.title: No behavioral test coverage for the embedding show/update actions
findings.body: This spec, like the embeddable_hosts_controller spec, only checks the class hierarchy. There's no test verifying `show` or `update` actually renders the expected serialized `embedding` payload containing `embeddable_hosts`, nor any check of the `fetch_embedding` before_filter behavior.

findings.title: Plural `_ids` hydration doesn't guard against failed subtype lookups
findings.body: In the new pluralized branch of `_hydrateEmbedded`, `obj[k].map(id => self._lookupSubType(subType, type, id, root))` is assigned directly to `obj[self.pluralize(subType)]` without filtering out `undefined` results, unlike the singular branch which only assigns when `hydrated` is truthy. If any id in the `_ids` array doesn't resolve to an object in the root payload's corresponding collection (e.g. a `color_ids` entry not present in the sideloaded `colors` array), the resulting array will contain `undefined` entries, which can cause runtime errors when templates/components call `.get()` on those entries.

findings.title: Client-side category badge can diverge from server-assigned category when none is chosen
findings.body: After `host.save(props)` succeeds, the component does `host.set('category', Discourse.Category.findById(this.get('categoryId')))`. If no category was selected (`categoryId` is null), this sets `category` to `undefined`, while the server (`Admin::EmbeddableHostsController#save_host`) falls back to `SiteSetting.uncategorized_category_id` for blank category_id. This leaves the UI showing no/blank category badge even though the host was actually persisted with the uncategorized category, until a full page reload re-fetches the correct data.

findings.title: No pretender mocks added for the new admin embedding endpoints
findings.body: This PR adds new client-side adapters/controllers/routes/components for managing embeddable hosts (`GET/PUT /admin/customize/embedding`, `POST/PUT/DELETE /admin/embeddable_hosts`), but no corresponding mock endpoints were added to the test pretender, and no new JS test files were added to exercise the admin-embedding route/controller/component. This leaves the entire new admin UI feature without JS test coverage.
